reason: Optional pre-implementation weight transfer candidate; not an approved balance or a gameplay Patch. Actual habitat/terrain validation and human review are required.

plant_roles.AMJ_Plant_Yoshi: Reed stands on river and low-marsh fringes; do not assume all cold peat wetlands permit reeds.
plant_roles.AMJ_Plant_Suge: Sedge-like grass on wet meadow and marginal bog; ecological proxy for Japanese sedges.
plant_roles.AMJ_Tree_Hannoki: Alder wetland woodland, primarily low-fen and margins; preserve total woody weight.
plant_roles.AMJ_Plant_Mizugoke: Sphagnum carpet in cool peat bogs, not uniform woody wetland cover.

change_rules: Replace part of Vanilla TallGrass with Yoshi and Suge in both retained wetland BiomeDefs.
Replace part of ColdBog Vanilla Moss with Mizugoke.
Transfer fractions of current wetland Willow/Maple/Birch woody weight to Hannoki, do not remove other accepted tree proxies.
Keep all other plant weights and Wild Healroot supply exactly unchanged.
Validate actual allowed terrain and map spawn densities before accepting any weights.
Do not make Environment depend on optional DLC or other vegetation Mods.
